112:<p align="justify">Our Institute Established under Open Door Policy of Govt.of India in August 1962 as a Non-Govt.Polytechnic Khurai started functioning as an Institution of Technical Education for Three Diploma in Engineering Programmes ,viz Civil ,Mechanical and Electrical . Later on it was taken over by the Govt. of M.P. in November 1984. The present intake is of 180 students every year ,60 each branch. The Institution has many firsts to its credit- It was the first Polytechnic in the state of M.P. to be designated as community Polytechnic by Govt.of India. It was the first Polytechnic in the State to have established its own Entrepreneurship Development Cell. It was again the first Polytechnic in the State to have EMD & IIPC (Entrepreneurship & Management Development and Institute -Industry Partnership Cell ) Schemes of AICTE.
